assessment_objectives.objective: assessed component configurations are included in the system component inventory.
approved deviations to secure baseline configurations are documented in the system component inventory.

configuration settings that reflect the most restrictive mode consistent with operational requirements are established and documented for components employed within the system using common secure configurations.
changes to the configuration settings are controlled in accordance with organizational policies and procedures.
any deviations from established configuration settings are identified and documented.
any deviations from established configuration settings are approved.
common secure configurations to establish and document configuration settings for components employed within the system are defined.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: DoD Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs); Center for Internet Security (CIS) Level 2 guidelines where STIGs are not available; custom baselines where CIS guidelines are not available

assessment_objectives.objective: system components for which approval of deviations is needed are defined.
operational requirements necessitating approval of deviations are defined.
changes to the configuration settings are monitored in accordance with organizational policies and procedures.
deviations to secure baseline configurations are assessed prior to being approved or denied.
the approval or denial decision for each deviation to secure baseline configurations is recorded.
